purpose: Falsify eight causal counterfactual mechanisms for ranking pre-open TDnet event names by same-session open-to-close profit. None is a threshold or hyperparameter variation of v10/T02 or v11 analog models.

point_in_time.training_rule: All outcomes used by matching, nuisance models, pseudo-outcomes, issuer controls, trees, leaf estimates, and final scorers have date strictly earlier than the first score date of the calendar month.
point_in_time.cross_fitting: For doubly robust pseudo-outcomes, assign complete training dates to three folds by chronological date ordinal modulo three; each nuisance prediction is made by a model fit on the other two folds. All dates remain prior to the scored month.
point_in_time.strict_tdnet_session: Every calendar day from the preceding panel session through the score session must have a cached TDnet index page. Sessions without this coverage are excluded and contribute neither trade nor cash observations.
point_in_time.training_filter: strict TDnet session, price_training_eligible true, observed open-to-close return, tdnet_clean_any observed
point_in_time.scoring_filter: strict TDnet session, price_eligible true, tdnet_clean_any observed
point_in_time.candidate_filter: tdnet_clean_any equals one; no-event rows are counterfactual controls and can never be selected
point_in_time.source_rule: candidate_price_source_max_date is null or strictly earlier than row date; tdnet_clean_feature_source_max_timestamp is no later than 08:58:59 on row date
point_in_time.target_mutation_test: In every score fold replace the score-month return and label columns before fitting/scoring and require exact score, allow-mask, and selected-key equality.

treatment_definition.estimand: conditional incremental open-to-close percentage return of the observed pre-open disclosure bundle versus the no-disclosure counterfactual
treatment_definition.warning: Disclosure occurrence is not random. These are falsification screens for stable counterfactual ranking signals, not causal identification claims.

implementation_lock.preprocessing: Fold-local median imputation with missing indicators and fold-local standardisation
implementation_lock.date_weighting: Every training date has total weight one; rows within a date share it equally
implementation_lock.propensity_model: LogisticRegression(C=1.0, L2, lbfgs, max_iter=500), probabilities clipped to [0.01,0.99]

matching.distance: Euclidean after fold-global control median imputation and standardisation

implementation_lock.overlap: Closed interval from max of treated/control propensity 5th percentiles to min of treated/control 95th percentiles, estimated on training rows

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: For each historical event row, subtract the mean outcome of ten same-date nearest no-event controls. Fit one Ridge CATE model to this matched pseudo-uplift using base and event covariates.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Local same-date matching removes latent day conditions while retaining event-specific incremental payoff.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Assign each event bundle to one primary family. Within each family fit separate treated and no-event Ridge outcome models and score their difference; require at least 50 treated training rows in the family.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Disclosure families have different response surfaces, so separate potential-outcome models outperform pooled direct prediction.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Construct three-fold date-grouped cross-fitted AIPW pseudo-outcomes with propensity and two outcome nuisance models, clip pseudo-outcomes to [-10,+10], then fit a Ridge CATE model using base and event covariates.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Doubly robust orthogonalisation isolates stable incremental disclosure payoff from selection into disclosure.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Subtract each historical date's date-weighted mean no-event return from each event return, then fit a Ridge model to event rows using base and event covariates.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: The relevant target is event excess over contemporaneous non-event opportunity cost, not raw return.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: For each scored event, estimate its issuer's prior event mean minus prior no-event mean, with each mean shrunk toward zero by twenty observations. No cross-issuer outcome model is fit.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Stable issuer-specific disclosure reaction dominates pooled text or price relations.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Fit pooled treated and no-event Ridge outcome models, but score only event rows whose propensity lies inside the fixed training overlap interval.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Counterfactual rankings are useful only where treated and no-event states have empirical covariate overlap.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Fit treated and no-event binary Ridge probability models for return above +1%. Multiply their probability difference by the treated training mean positive return conditional on exceeding +1%.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Profit is concentrated in event-driven upside jumps, so positive-tail uplift is a better action value than conditional mean.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Build cross-fitted AIPW pseudo-outcomes. Use the first half of training dates to learn a depth-three tree partition, and the second half to estimate each leaf's pseudo-outcome mean with a one-hundred-observation zero prior.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: A small honest partition can express discontinuous event-policy regimes without reusing observations for split selection and leaf payoff estimation.

portfolio.cash_rule: A scheduled slot is executed only when predicted uplift is strictly greater than +0.40%. Empty or rejected slots remain cash; surviving slots retain weight 1/capacity and are not renormalised.
portfolio.scheduled_day_denominator: Every strict complete score session, including full-cash days

evaluation.primary_metric: strict scheduled-day arithmetic mean net40 return
reported: win rate, monthly net40 and three fixed temporal slices
best and worst 5/10/20 scheduled days removed
executed slots, traded days, cash days, unique codes
largest and top-ten code weight share
top-ten positive-P&L codes replaced by cash
evaluation.multiplicity: 5000 deterministic circular moving-block resamples of strict sessions, block length 10. Report one-sided studentised familywise max-t 95% lower bounds and White-style reality-check adjusted p-values against zero over all sixteen policies.
evaluation.selection_rule: Freeze the highest net40 candidate only if it passes every retrospective gate; otherwise freeze none.

production_gate.failure_action: Reject this causal family and preregister a genuinely different mechanism; do not tune these eight hypotheses.
